name: codepulse
description: Privacy-first coding activity tracker. Tracks active time, idle detection, WPM, and language usage — all data stays local.

codepulse.idleTimeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before CodePulse considers you idle.

codepulse.showWpm.description: Show words-per-minute in the status bar.

walkthroughs.title: Welcome to CodePulse
walkthroughs.description: Privacy-first coding activity tracking. All data stays on your machine.

steps.title: Your Coding Dashboard
steps.description:
CodePulse tracks your active coding time, typing speed (WPM), and language usage — right in the status bar.

[Show Stats](command:codepulse.showStats)

steps.title: 100% Private
steps.description:
Zero telemetry. Zero network calls. All data is stored locally on your machine.

You own your data — export it anytime as JSON or CSV.

steps.title: Your Status Bar
steps.description:
Look at the status bar — you'll see your active time, current language, and WPM.

Click it for a full breakdown of today's stats.

steps.title: Export Your Data
steps.description:
Use the Command Palette and search for **CodePulse: Export Data** to save your stats as JSON or CSV.

[Export Data](command:codepulse.exportData)
